logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the B verification memo of WO-01 (water-reclamation pump module selection, client Civic Water Engineering, synthetic). A clean two-panel analytical figure on white background, sans-serif labels, no decorative art. Left panel: vertical bar chart of measured energy per common acceptance run from the trusted table - P2 12 kWh, P3 52 kWh, P1 56 kWh, P4 58 kWh - with the winner bar in green (#1A7A4C) and the three rivals in blue (#26679A). Gridlines at 0, 20, 40, 60 kWh; exact values labeled above each bar; gap annotations +40, +44, +46 kWh relative to P2 placed on the rival bars; x-axis candidate IDs; caption strip noting the losing cluster spans only 6 kWh. Right panel: a compact verification record box titled 'B verification record' listing: all four candidates qualify (P4 81/0, P3 80/3, P2 97/1, P1 84/4); ranking by energy P2<P3<P1<P4; Correction 1 in dark red - quality margin P2 minus P4 equals 16 points, A's brief said 17; Correction 2 in dark red - the 40 kWh gap equals 3.33x P2's energy, A's brief said fourfold; savings line 76.9/78.6/79.3 percent; ballot line P2; a grey footnote that cost, delivery and reliability remain unverified. The figure must read as an independent audit of A's decision brief, not as a copy of it.
